{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Identify QA orders in loyal segment
qa_in_loyal = qa_orders[qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Drop QA orders from the dataset
df_clean = df[~df.index.isin(qa_in_loyal.index)].copy()

# Now compute conversion fraction for loyal customers
loyal_customers = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
num_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()
num_total = len(loyal_customers)
conversion_fraction = num_converted / num_total

print(f"Number of loyal customers after removing QA: {num_total}")
print(f"Number converted: {num_converted}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")

# Return the value for submission
conversion_fraction"}
